findings.name: Xscape (Scotiabank Theatre Winnipeg)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv games list only Ferrari F355 Challenge and Sno Cross. No music games section. Official XSCAPE pitch: air hockey, driving games, prize cranes.
findings.note: Cineplex XSCAPE FEC. No positive 'no music games' blurb on this page. Absence only, not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Xscape (SilverCity Brampton Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade formerly had an In The Groove 2 machine as of August 2022. Sadly, dance machines are no longer available.
findings.note: Positive ZIv statement that dance machines are gone. Remaining list is Halo Fireteam Raven, ticket/redemption games.

findings.name: Xscape (SilverCity London Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv lists only Operation G.H.O.S.T., Dream Raiders, Extreme Hoops. No music games listed and no explicit no-music statement.
findings.note: Sparse ZIv inventory. Typical XSCAPE redemption mix; no positive confirmed_none text.

findings.name: Xscape (SilverCity Richmond Hill Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv lists MotoGP, Fast and the Furious Super Cars, Halo Fireteam Raven, ticket games, hockey table. No music games section.
findings.note: No explicit no-dance statement on this page.

findings.name: Xscape (SilverCity Riverport Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: There used to be a Dance Dance Revolution Extreme. It is now gone, being mostly replaced with ticket games. However, a few racing games and other traditional games remain.
findings.note: Positive statement that former DDR Extreme was removed and replaced by ticket/redemption.

findings.name: Xscape (SilverCity St. Vital Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: There are no dance games and very few worthwhile games here. It is mostly casino-style and carnaval-style games. I use this video from December 19, 2022, as the basis for the arcade listings: https://youtu.be/kcMc4_ne9xQ
findings.note: Explicit no-dance-games statement plus walkthrough video basis. Inventory is redemption/racing only.

findings.name: Xscape (SilverCity Sudbury Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: Comment by LABcrab (2 months before 2026-08-04 check, ~2026-05): RIP In The Groove 2! Current games list: MotoGP Arcade only.
findings.note: Former ITG2 removed (community RIP). No remaining music games on ZIv as of 2026-05 update.

findings.name: Xscape (SilverCity Thunder Bay Cinemas)

findings.note: No explicit no-music statement. Absence only.

findings.name: Xscape (SilverCity Victoria Cinemas)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv lists Pac-Man Battle Royale DLX, Dead Heat, Jurassic Park Arcade, Key Master, Extreme Shot. No music games section.
findings.note: No positive confirmed_none text.

findings.name: ZED*80
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International), Free Play. Arcade bar with old school games, all machines set to free play with $10 cover.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade is the only ZIv Music Game entry; no Bemani/PIU/DDR. Mapped to slug other (no dedicated GHA slug). Free-play bar at 185 Danforth Ave Toronto. Website zedeighty.com.

findings.name: Zap Zone
findings.evidence_quote: MARTER1234: Extreme cab was removed and auctioned off back in 2019. LABcrab: It is quite possible that DDR Extreme is no longer here... I can't find photos of a dance machine this year. Here's hoping that Zap Zone picks up StepManiaX or Pump It Up.
findings.note: Former DDR Extreme removed 2019 per ZIv. Official zapzone.ca Windsor arcade page markets redemption (Skee Ball, Mario Kart, etc.), no dance/rhythm. No replacement music game found.

findings.name: Dance Dance Revolution Solo 2000 / In The Groove
